newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish garment maker Delia IPO seen in 97 or 98.
newsitem.headline: Polish garment maker Delia IPO seen in 97 or 98.

text.p: Polish garment maker Delia SA, a subsidiary of Mostostal Export, has pushed back its planned public offering from early 1997 to later in the year or the following year, Mostostal's deputy president said.
Wojciech Rzepka told Reuters on Wednesday that Delia would issue up to 1.5 million zlotys in shares for Mostostal, raising its stake to above 90 percent from 85 percent.
Delia would thus near the minimum share capital level needed for a listing on the bourse's parallel market, he said.
"The main reason was that the firm's capital was too low...and now after the issue we'll be near the minimum," Wojciech Rzepka told Reuters on Wednesday.
Rzepka said Delia, based in Zamosc, southeastern Poland, would use the proceeds from the issue largely to modernise production.

He said the firm, which currently had a share capital of two million zlotys, would fulfil its plan to net 660,000 zlotys this year on sales of 25 million zlotys after earning 600,000 zlotys last year on sales of 20 million zlotys.
